fit.sheet: TI TL07xx data sheet SLOS080W (revised July 2025), TL07xC at ±15 V
fit.figure: 5.8 and 5.9 (TL07xC) at ±15 V: AOL 200 V/mV typ, GBW 3 MHz (the classic die: NS/PS packages and M grades; 5.25 MHz on newer dies), slew rate 20 V/µs, phase margin 56° (G = +1, RL 10 kΩ, CL 20 pF), open-loop output impedance 125 Ω, quiescent current 1.4 mA per amplifier, VOM ±13.5 V typ at 10 kΩ
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. Output resistance the sheet's 125 Ω, clamps 1.33 V from each rail so the 10 kΩ swing lands on the typical ±13.5 V. Replaces TI's 1989 macromodel, whose RP (2.143 kΩ across the supplies) drew 12.6 mA a channel at 27 V against the sheet's 1.4 mA (D-219).
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ).
